Privacy

We collect the name and email you give us when you join or register for a workshop, and we use them to send you the things you asked for. Nothing else.

We do not sell member data, and we do not share it with advertisers. Workshop recordings are hosted on Zoom under their retention terms.

To see what we hold on you or to have it deleted, email privacy@profynacademy.com and we will action it within 30 days.

Notes saved on lessons stay in your own browser. They are never sent to us and clearing your browser data removes them.

Terms

Profyn Academy is educational. Nothing on this site is personalised financial, tax or legal advice, and none of our instructors are acting as your licensed adviser. Talk to a professional before making a decision that matters.

Certificates record that you completed a Profyn track. They are not a regulated qualification and carry no licensing weight.

Membership is free. We may cap workshop seats, and we may remove accounts that abuse the community.

Questions: hello@profynacademy.com
